description: For hard-to-book Walt Disney World restaurants: how often cancelled reservations reappear ("drops"), the probability of catching one, and the best day-of-week and hour to look. Disneyland Resort parks (disneyland, california-adventure) are accepted; they return quality_state "unavailable" until Disneyland Resort data is connected.

park.description: Filter to restaurants in this park.

resort.description: Resort: "wdw" (Walt Disney World, the default) or "dlr" (Disneyland Resort). A park argument, when given, decides the resort.

name: get_dining_drop_odds
title: Dining reservation drop odds
